summary: Consolidated 6 sorry stubs in KampBypassK1.lean into 2 structurally identical sorries via nonconstenv_3var_exist_transfer helper. All quantifier zones in nf_eval_from_enriched_witnesses now handled uniformly. Build passes.

sorry_inventory.assumption: depth-(K+2) 2-var NF agreement at [x,t]/[x',t'] from pointwise depth-(K+2) 1-var agreements at x/x' and t/t'
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Genuine infrastructure gap: constructing non-constant env multi-var NF agreement from pointwise 1-var agreements. The circularity is that exist_transfer_from_full_agree needs the multi-var agreement to produce the existential transfer, but the existential transfer IS the quantifier condition of the multi-var agreement. prior_nonconstenv_2var_agree_until solves this for K>=1 but has a sorry at K=0 (the original motivation for the bypass).
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Prove nonconstenv_3var_exist_transfer by (a) induction on depth with a new existential-transfer bootstrap, (b) using prior_nonconstenv_2var_agree_until for K>=1 and a separate K=0 argument, or (c) a completely new approach to non-constant env agreement.

sorry_inventory.assumption: depth-(K+1) 3-var NF agreement at [w,x,t]/[w0,x0,t0] from pointwise depth-(K+2) 1-var agreements at w/w0, x/x0, t/t0
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Same infrastructure gap as nonconstenv_3var_exist_transfer but at 3-var env instead of 2-var.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Same resolution as nonconstenv_3var_exist_transfer - both collapse to the same problem.

blockers: Non-constant env multi-var NF agreement from pointwise 1-var agreements: no existing theorem handles this without Prior axiom-based transfer (which is false at K=0). Need new infrastructure, likely involving induction on depth with a novel bootstrap mechanism.

proved: nonconstenv_3var_exist_transfer structure: reduces 3-var existential transfer to 2-var agreement via exist_transfer_from_full_agree
nf_eval_from_enriched_witnesses: all quantifier zones handled uniformly (no zone case split needed)
zone3_from_bracket: quantifier part structured via exist_transfer_from_full_agree from 3-var agreement
zone3_from_bracket: full atom part (predicates + all 6 order cases) [pre-existing]
nf_eval_from_enriched_witnesses: full atom part for 2-var env [pre-existing]
continuation_context.key_insight: All 6 original sorry stubs were instances of the same problem: transferring existentials at non-constant envs from pointwise 1-var agreements. The nonconstenv_3var_exist_transfer helper captures this precisely: it reduces the 3-var existential transfer to depth-(K+2) 2-var agreement via exist_transfer_from_full_agree. The 2-var agreement is the ONLY remaining sorry. This is mathematically identical to prior_nonconstenv_2var_agree_until's K=0 sorry, which is the root problem the bypass was designed to circumvent.
